'''Fluid Pump''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|Requires power. A facility for pumping fluids.|The Endfield manufacturing center constructs this pressure engine by attaching a power module to a basic water pump purchased by the Procurement Division.}}
==Usage==
Requires power. A facility for pumping fluids, such as [[Clean Water]].
*Power Use : 10
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Fluid Pumping]]
